newsitem.title: USA: Microtest names president, financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Microtest names president, financial chief.

text.p: Microtest Inc on Monday said it named Charles Mihaylo president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer.

As president, he replaces Richard Meise, who remains chairman and chief executive officer. The former chief financial officer was Richard Douglas, who resigned. The post of chief operating officer is newly created.
Before joining Microtest, Mihaylo was president of Inter-Tel NetSolutions Inc, a subsidiary of Inter-Tel Inc .
Microtest makes diagnostic certification and CD-connectivity products for local area networks and enterprise networks.
